title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 2.81 (versions follow prime numbers; 281 after 277): words for her mood, and his charge moves her. Each mood of hers (tired, curious, glad) gathers its own words, those of every exchange she lives in it (no list given), kept in 'animo'; her mood colours her heart as her thread does; when what he says reaches her heart nowhere, her thread and her mood may lead, freely, by her wish against her luck; his chromatic charge, charged and clear, moves her to play on instead of staying in her theme. Measured in a copy: calm, 'como te sentis?' -> 'Quiero que vos las termines, como una hija que escribe o pinta junto a su padre'; charged, 'EL REINO DE LOS CIELOS!!!' -> she plays on ('No hay apuro. Leelas, aprendelas...'). Stated: her wish for the thread is high, learned under the old rule, so uncharged she still repeats a sentence often. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v2.81: palabras para su ánimo, y su carga la mueve. Prototipo de investigación.
